thread:
rachel: Heads-up: rack-12 in APAC is showing repeated p95 GPU latency spikes starting ~00:20 UTC. NVLink/PCIe write bursts coincide with high DMA from tenant 'video-transcode'. KV cache churn on sibling pods.

toby: Any recent batch multiplier changes or quant updates?

rachel: They pushed a staging change that doubled chunk size at 00:18. Looks correlated.

infra-bot: alert: pcie-burst-detector fired on rack-12 at 00:27 UTC; assigned to @rachel.

leila: Short mitigation: enable dma_guard eBPF that caps DMA write bursts per-tenant to 60MB/s for 40m. Low-risk and quick.

ben: Also propose an ephemeral preemptible slice (1 node) for latency-SLA tenants in that AZ so noisy tenant can't take down whole shelf. Cost impact small but measurable.

rachel: Applying eBPF cap now. Command: 
ssh ops@rack-12 sudo /opt/tools/dma_guard --tenant video-transcode --limit 60MB

infra-bot: action: dma_guard applied at 00:34 UTC.

leila: Post-cap metrics: PCIe writes down ~45%, KV evictions down ~30%, p95 improved but p99 still slightly high for a couple of tenants.

ben: Plan: run 48h experiment with ephemeral preemptible slice + router qos tag (qos:lowlat). Track p50/p95/p99, evictions, and delta monthly cost. If cost delta < $2k and p99 improves >20% keep it.

rachel: I'll own the experiment. Add runbook step to preempt and evacuate slice on shortage. Link runbook in #oncall.

leila: Long-term: add per-tenant DMA quotas and shard-aware KV quotas to prevent whole-host fallout. Adding to backlog.

rachel: Closing: short mitigation applied, experiment planned. Escalate if p99 > 300ms for 5m. :white_check_mark:
